name: Com chay sot de
summary: Ninh Bình’s crisp rice cake eaten with goat sauce, where the province’s two best-known foods meet on one plate.
origin: Ninh Bình, at the goat table.
howToEat: Break the cake into the goat sauce at the table.
where: The roads and lanes toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính, where the dê núi shops are.
seoTitle: Com chay sot de — crisp rice, goat sauce
seoDescription: Crisp cơm cháy with goat sauce, the Ninh Bình plate where crisp rice and mountain goat meet.
